name: clotheskin
description: Kindroid app: where a Kin is, its pose and action and what it is wearing, read from its recent chat, with automatic updates and a sleep and dream cycle.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-screen.mjs && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-test-script.mjs
scripts.build:check: node scripts/build-screen.mjs --check && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/build-test-script.mjs --check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run unused-exports && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:perf && npm run build:check
